units.source_text: 太阳光像煮沸了的水银，沿着沙壁的边缘照射下来，火辣辣地烧灼着洞底的地面。

en.t: The sunlight, like boiling mercury, streamed down along the edge of the sand wall, scorching the ground at the bottom of the pit.

units.source_text: 眼前豁然敞亮，把他的眼睛都照花了，他慌忙垂下眼帘。

en.t: The space before him suddenly opened into brightness, dazzling his eyes, and he hurriedly lowered his eyelids.

units.source_text: 下一个瞬间，他像是忘记了那炫目的光，眼睛直愣愣地凝视着正面的沙壁。

en.t: The next instant, as if he had forgotten the blinding light, he stared fixedly at the sand wall directly in front of him.
